official_sources.title: Google Developers Blog: Transitioning Gemini CLI to Antigravity CLI
official_sources.finding: Gemini CLI / Gemini Code Assist individual requests stop on 2026-06-18; Antigravity CLI is the replacement lane.

official_sources.title: Gemini Code Assist for individuals
official_sources.finding: Consumer/individual Gemini Code Assist and Gemini CLI requests stop on 2026-06-18; standard and enterprise tiers are not impacted.

official_sources.title: Firebase extension for Gemini CLI
official_sources.finding: The Firebase extension for Gemini CLI stops working on 2026-06-18; migrate Firebase agent work to Antigravity CLI.

official_sources.title: Firebase release notes
official_sources.finding: Firebase repeats the 2026-06-18 Gemini CLI extension shutdown and directs users to Antigravity CLI / direct Firebase agent skills.

official_sources.title: Gemini API model docs
official_sources.finding: Gemini API model usage remains separate from deprecated Gemini CLI tooling.

guardrails: Do not add `gemini extensions install https://github.com/firebase/agent-skills/` to scripts, CI, or setup docs.
Do not require `google.geminicodeassist` or the individual Gemini Code Assist IDE extension in .vscode recommendations.
Use Antigravity CLI / Antigravity IDE for the Google agent lane; keep Gemini API usage as API/model integration only.
Keep historical docs only when they explicitly describe the migration or shutdown context.
